chunks: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from al-'Amraki, from 'Ali ibn Ja'far, from his brother Musa ibn Ja'far عليهما السلام, who said:

I asked him about a man who remembered, while he was in his salat (prayer), that he had not performed istinja' after relieving himself. He said: “He should leave, perform istinja' after relieving himself, and repeat the salat (prayer).”
And we have already covered what relates to this chapter in the Book of Taharah (ritual purity), and there is sufficient discussion there, if Allah wills.

key_terms.الطَّهَارَةِ: ritual purity, the legal state and rulings of cleanliness
key_terms.الْخَلَاءِ: the place of relieving oneself; the toilet
key_terms.صَلَاتِهِ: his salat (prayer), the ritual prayer he was performing
key_terms.يَسْتَنْجِ: to perform istinja', cleansing oneself after relieving oneself
key_terms.يَنْصَرِفُ: he should leave or break off the prayer
key_terms.يُعِيدُ: he should repeat or perform again

ai.seo_question: What should a person do if he remembers during salat (prayer) that he did not perform istinja'?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning one who remembers during salat (prayer) that he did not perform istinja' after using the toilet. The ruling is that he must break off the prayer, perform istinja', and then repeat the salat (prayer).
